name: Dock Workspaces
author: Sean Kennedy
description: When an external display is plugged in, send workspaces to it — except ones you created or filled on the laptop during the last dual-monitor session.
postEnable:
Jump on connect needs a Hyprland loader. Open the bar icon and click Add Hyprland loader, or run:
  ~/.config/omarchy/plugins/seanpk.dock-workspaces/bin/install-loader

barWidget.description: Restore workspaces onto the primary display on dock, keeping laptop-owned ones put.
